purpose: Measure whether the exact-qualified TP2 MTP2 deployment retains an aggregate advantage at 64 concurrent users under corrected deterministic admission and exact output identity.
hardware: Two local Intel Arc Pro B70 cards; no remote host.
fixed_configuration: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M target, TP2 tensor 1,1, tuned target profile, Q4_K reorder enabled in both arms, WDC disabled, 64 slots, 32768 total context, batch 2048, ubatch 256, cache off, temperature 0, seed 42, 128 tokens per request.

admission_contract.reason: The 2520 ms launch span remains within one server admission window, removing request-to-slot mapping as an output confound.

arms: Fresh MTP0 control generates the sole c64 ordered oracle after all batch gates pass.
Fresh MTP2 candidate must match that frozen oracle 64/64 exactly.
candidate_delta: Enable the external Q4_0 MTP draft at depth 2; target model, target arithmetic, server binary, admission order, workload, and all other runtime settings remain fixed.
required_gates: candidate token-ID digests exactly match the frozen MTP0 c64 oracle 64/64
all cached token counts are zero
complete token-ID identity and collision gates pass
no GPU fault, reset, device loss, OOM, or model-process segfault
publication_policy: Publish only measured output-qualified aggregate throughput. No interpolation, extrapolation, fixture reuse, or shape-variant output allowance.
